verdict: Organic engagement is softening across all three entities; CRM buildout accelerating.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all activity this period is organic — paid channels carried zero spend and zero leads for the full 28 days. Combined Google Business Profile actions totaled 408 across the three entities, but engagement has dropped sharply in the most recent 7 days, with GBP actions down 63%, 22%, and 53% respectively versus the prior week, and search clicks trending in the same direction. The visibility softening is being addressed through a site reindexing effort already in motion, with three properties targeted for recovery by end of October. On the CRM side, overdue milestones — including stub account reconciliation and outreach sequence launches — are the primary blocker on pipeline activity, and resolution of those items is the focus heading into November.
